# Rosalind Problem: Implement_GibbsSampler in Ada

## Problem Understanding

The Gibbs Sampler is a Markov Chain Monte Carlo algorithm used for sampling from a joint probability distribution. In the context of bioinformatics, it's commonly used for motif finding in DNA sequences.

## Solution Implementation

```ada
with Ada.Text_IO; use Ada.Text_IO;
with Ada.Integer_Text_IO; use Ada.Integer_Text_IO;
with Ada.Float_Text_IO; use Ada.Float_Text_IO;
with Ada.Numerics.Float_Random;

procedure Implement_GibbsSampler is
   
   type Sequence is array (Positive range <>) of Character;
   type DNA_Sequences is array (Positive range <>) of Sequence;
   
   -- Constants
   N_MOTIFS : constant := 10;      -- Number of motifs to find
   L_MOTIF : constant := 20;       -- Length of each motif
   N_ITERATIONS : constant := 1000; -- Number of iterations
   
   -- Random number generator
   package Random_Float is new Ada.Numerics.Float_Random;
   Gen : Random_Float.Generator;
   
   -- Sample a random integer between 1 and N
   function Rand_Int(N : Positive) return Positive is
   begin
      return Positive(Random_Float.Random(Gen) * Float(N)) + 1;
   end Rand_Int;
   
   -- Sample a random real number between 0.0 and 1.0
   function Rand_Real return Float is
   begin
      return Random_Float.Random(Gen);
   end Rand_Real;
   
   -- Compute the profile matrix from motifs
   procedure Compute_Profile(
      Motifs : DNA_Sequences;
      Profile : out array (Positive range 1..4, Positive range 1..L_MOTIF) of Float
   ) is
      N : constant Positive := Motifs'Length;
   begin
      -- Initialize profile matrix with pseudocounts
      for i in 1..4 loop
         for j in 1..L_MOTIF loop
            Profile(i,j) := 1.0; -- Pseudocount
         end loop;
      end loop;
      
      -- Count nucleotides at each position
      for i in 1..N loop
         for j in 1..L_MOTIF loop
            case Motifs(i)(j) is
               when 'A' => Profile(1,j) := Profile(1,j) + 1.0;
               when 'C' => Profile(2,j) := Profile(2,j) + 1.0;
               when 'G' => Profile(3,j) := Profile(3,j) + 1.0;
               when 'T' => Profile(4,j) := Profile(4,j) + 1.0;
            end case;
         end loop;
      end loop;
      
      -- Convert counts to probabilities
      for j in 1..L_MOTIF loop
         declare
            Total : Float := 0.0;
         begin
            for i in 1..4 loop
               Total := Total + Profile(i,j);
            end loop;
            
            for i in 1..4 loop
               Profile(i,j) := Profile(i,j) / Total;
            end loop;
         end;
      end loop;
   end Compute_Profile;
   
   -- Calculate probability of a k-mer given profile
   function Probability_Motif(
      Motif : Sequence;
      Profile : array (Positive range 1..4, Positive range 1..L_MOTIF) of Float
   ) return Float is
      Result : Float := 1.0;
   begin
      for i in 1..L_MOTIF loop
         case Motif(i) is
            when 'A' => Result := Result * Profile(1,i);
            when 'C' => Result := Result * Profile(2,i);
            when 'G' => Result := Result * Profile(3,i);
            when 'T' => Result := Result * Profile(4,i);
         end case;
      end loop;
      return Result;
   end Probability_Motif;
   
   -- Sample a motif from the probability distribution
   function Sample_Motif(
      Sequences : DNA_Sequences;
      Profile : array (Positive range 1..4, Positive range 1..L_MOTIF) of Float;
      Start_Position : Positive;
      Length : Positive
   ) return Sequence is
      -- Create a list of probabilities for all possible motifs
      type Motif_Prob is record
         Motif : Sequence;
         Prob : Float;
      end record;
      
      Motif_List : array (Positive range 1..Sequences'Length - Length + 1) of Motif_Prob;
      Total_Prob : Float := 0.0;
      Random_Value : Float;
   begin
      -- Generate all possible motifs at given start position
      for i in 1..Sequences'Length - Length + 1 loop
         declare
            Temp_Motif : Sequence(1..Length);
         begin
            for j in 1..Length loop
               Temp_Motif(j) := Sequences(i)(j + Start_Position - 1);
            end loop;
            Motif_List(i).Motif := Temp_Motif;
            Motif_List(i).Prob := Probability_Motif(Temp_Motif, Profile);
            Total_Prob := Total_Prob + Motif_List(i).Prob;
         end;
      end loop;
      
      -- Sample using the probability distribution
      Random_Value := Rand_Real * Total_Prob;
      declare
         Cumulative : Float := 0.0;
      begin
         for i in 1..Motif_List'Length loop
            Cumulative := Cumulative + Motif_List(i).Prob;
            if Random_Value <= Cumulative then
               return Motif_List(i).Motif;
            end if;
         end loop;
      end;
      
      -- Fallback (should not happen)
      return Motif_List(1).Motif;
   end Sample_Motif;
   
   -- Gibbs Sampler implementation
   procedure Gibbs_Sampler(
      Sequences : DNA_Sequences;
      Best_Motifs : out DNA_Sequences
   ) is
      -- Initialize motifs randomly
      Current_Motifs : DNA_Sequences(1..N_MOTIFS);
      Best_Score : Float := Float'Last;
      Temp_Score : Float;
      
      -- Random initialization of motifs
      procedure Initialize_Random_Motifs is
      begin
         for i in 1..N_MOTIFS loop
            declare
               Start_Pos : constant Positive := Rand_Int(Sequences(i)'Length - L_MOTIF + 1);
            begin
               Current_Motifs(i) := Sequences(i)(Start_Pos..Start_Pos + L_MOTIF - 1);
            end;
         end loop;
      end Initialize_Random_Motifs;
      
      -- Calculate score for motifs (sum of negative log probabilities)
      function Score_Motifs(Motifs : DNA_Sequences) return Float is
         Profile : array (Positive range 1..4, Positive range 1..L_MOTIF) of Float;
         Total_Score : Float := 0.0;
      begin
         Compute_Profile(Motifs, Profile);
         for i in 1..N_MOTIFS loop
            declare
               Prob : constant Float := Probability_Motif(Motifs(i), Profile);
            begin
               if Prob > 0.0 then
                  Total_Score := Total_Score - Float'Minimum(Prob, 1.0) * 1000.0; -- Simplified scoring
               end if;
            end;
         end loop;
         return Total_Score;
      end Score_Motifs;
      
   begin
      Initialize_Random_Motifs;
      
      for iteration in 1..N_ITERATIONS loop
         declare
            Random_Index : constant Positive := Rand_Int(N_MOTIFS);
            Temp_Motifs : DNA_Sequences(1..N_MOTIFS);
            Profile : array (Positive range 1..4, Positive range 1..L_MOTIF) of Float;
         begin
            -- Compute profile excluding the random motif
            for i in 1..N_MOTIFS loop
               if i /= Random_Index then
                  Temp_Motifs(i) := Current_Motifs(i);
               end if;
            end loop;
            
            Compute_Profile(Temp_Motifs, Profile);
            
            -- Sample new motif from sequence at random_index
            declare
               Start_Pos : constant Positive := Rand_Int(Sequences(Random_Index)'Length - L_MOTIF + 1);
            begin
               Current_Motifs(Random_Index) := 
                  Sample_Motif(Sequences, Profile, Start_Pos, L_MOTIF);
            end;
            
            -- Update best motifs if current is better
            Temp_Score := Score_Motifs(Current_Motifs);
            if Temp_Score < Best_Score then
               Best_Score := Temp_Score;
               for i in 1..N_MOTIFS loop
                  Best_Motifs(i) := Current_Motifs(i);
               end loop;
            end if;
         end;
      end loop;
   end Gibbs_Sampler;
   
   -- Sample DNA sequences (example data)
   Sequences : DNA_Sequences(1..5);
   
begin
   -- Initialize random generator
   Random_Float.Reset(Gen);
   
   -- Example DNA sequences (replace with actual input)
   Sequences(1) := "
